WHY: Context-conditioned coefficients let blend weights and the decision surface shift per coupon/distance/expiration segment (e.g., trust MLP more for Bar, LGBM for Restaurants, more acceptance prior lift for 2h Coffee House), directly attacking the systematic segment bias behind the plateau, while OOF-accuracy selection and L2 regularization keep the ~11-column meta model from overfitting 8k rows.
